map.输入异常幅值、半宽与梯度，结合形态特征推断可能地质体: Enter the anomaly amplitude, half-width and gradient to infer the likely geological body from the morphological characteristics.
map.推测埋深 ≈ 异常半宽 W / 1.31（Peters 半宽法）: Estimated burial depth ≈ anomaly half-width W / 1.31 (Peters half-width method)
map.磁异常幅值 > 500 nT 为高幅值、> 100 nT 中幅值；重力异常 >: A magnetic anomaly amplitude > 500 nT is high, > 100 nT medium; a gravity anomaly > 5 mGal is high, > 1 mGal medium; combined with half-width (> 200 m large) and gradient grading, the type and depth of the geological body are interpreted.
map.💡 依据幅值强度、范围大小与梯度陡缓推断埋深与地质体规模；梯度 G=ΔA/Δx: 💡 The burial depth and size of the geological body are inferred from amplitude strength, extent and gradient steepness; the gradient G=ΔA/Δx reflects the lateral rate of change of the anomaly.
map.解译为定性推断，需结合地质资料验证: The interpretation is qualitative and must be verified against geological data
map.磁异常高幅值多对应磁性矿体或岩体: A high-amplitude magnetic anomaly usually corresponds to a magnetic ore body or rock mass
map.重力高常对应致密岩体或金属矿化: A gravity high often corresponds to a dense rock mass or metal mineralisation
map.实际解译应进行定量反演计算: Actual interpretation should include quantitative inversion
map.📚 深度解析：物探异常形态解译与埋深估算（Peters 法）: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Geophysical Anomaly Morphology Interpretation and Depth Estimation (Peters Method)
map.形态分级：由幅值、半宽、梯度判异常特征（高/中/低幅值、大/中/小范围、陡/缓梯: Morphology grading: judge the anomaly characteristics from amplitude, half-width and gradient (high/medium/low amplitude, large/medium/small extent, steep/gentle gradient)
map.埋深估算：用 Peters 半宽法 depth≈半宽/1.31 估磁性/密度体顶: Depth estimation: use the Peters half-width method depth ≈ half-width / 1.31 to estimate the burial depth of the top of the magnetic/density body
map.靶区筛选：结合置信度给出可能地质体推断，辅助找矿与进一步工程布置: Target screening: give a likely geological-body inference with a confidence level, aiding prospecting and further engineering layout
map.解译逻辑：按异常类型（磁/重力）分别设幅值阈值（磁 >500nT 高、>100: Interpretation logic: amplitude thresholds are set by anomaly type (magnetic >500 nT high, >100 medium; gravity >5 mGal high, >1 medium), half-width >200 m large, 50-200 medium, <50 small, and gradient >5 steep. Depth ≈ half-width W / 1.31 (Peters half-width method, suitable for near-equidimensional magnetic bodies). Computed locally; the ambiguity must be resolved with geology.
map.例：磁异常 A=500nT、半宽 W=80m、梯度=6 → 中幅值、中等范围、陡: Example: magnetic anomaly A=500 nT, half-width W=80 m, gradient=6 → medium amplitude, medium extent, steep gradient; depth ≈80/1.31=61.07 m (medium depth). With medium amplitude and 50<W≤200, it is inferred to be a medium-scale dyke/contact zone (medium confidence); verify with a geological section and a small amount of drilling.
map.仅对近似等轴、产状简单、无干扰的磁性体较准，且常高估（因未扣背景与叠加）。真实埋: It is accurate only for near-equidimensional magnetic bodies of simple attitude and without interference, and it often overestimates (because the background and superposition are not removed). The true depth should come from inversion or quantitative section interpretation; this estimate is only a preliminary ranking and is for reference.
map.异常一定对应矿体吗？: Does an anomaly always correspond to an ore body?
map.不一定。磁性/密度异常也来自岩体、构造或干扰。需排除地表干扰、结合围岩与蚀变综合: Not necessarily. Magnetic/density anomalies also come from rock masses, structures or interference. Surface interference must be excluded and the host rock and alteration considered; low-confidence inferences need particular care to avoid the misjudgement of "ore at every anomaly".
map.物探异常定性解译工具，依据异常幅值、半宽与梯度等形态特征，推断可能地质体类型与埋: A qualitative geophysical anomaly interpretation tool: from morphological characteristics such as anomaly amplitude, half-width and gradient, infer the likely type and depth of the geological body and give an ambiguous inference with a confidence level, aiding the interpretation of geophysical results.
map.磁异常与重力异常双模式: Dual mode for magnetic and gravity anomalies
map.特征自动分级与埋深估算: Automatic feature grading and depth estimation
map.纯前端推断，数据本地处理: Fully client-side inference; data processed locally
map.物探异常初步定性解译: Preliminary qualitative interpretation of geophysical anomalies
